issueReference.title: Telescreen v1.3: Sentry parity for UI and features (self-review follow-up)
issueReference.planAcceptance: plan revision comm-000486 (fixes for Step 5 findings comm-000485) accepted by step5-impl-plan-review comm-000487; P5R-F1 and P5R-F2 verified fixed; no repair requests

reviewContext.userProblem: The owner asked (translated): 'Self-review the UI and the features. Are we providing the same usability and functionality as Sentry? If not, improve it.' The committed self-review found 7 defects (B1 reversed First/Latest navigation, B2 assigned:none raising RECIPIENT_UNKNOWN, B3 regressed/acknowledged/in_progress hidden by is:unresolved, B4 raw member ids as assignees, B5 negation dropped, B6 activity without actors, B7 navigation/chart/tags over a page instead of all findings) and a 60-item Sentry gap table (9 present, 23 partial, 28 missing).
requiredOutcomes: B1-B7 fixed with regression tests that fail on 57f389b.

S1 stream tabs with counts, period picker, per-issue trend, Values column, priority and trending sorts, display names, auto-refresh banner; S2 server query language (negation, has:, dates, comparisons, priority:, assigned:none, assigned:#team, is:*) and server saved views; S3 bulk and merge/unmerge; S4 archived (four conditions, bounded by 90 days) and escalating statuses; S5 Sentry-like issue detail; S6 alert rules with action interval, mute and history; S7 per-user notification settings, mention/subscription delivery and weekly report; S8 dashboard; S9 integrations, tokens, member edit/deactivate, ownership rules; S10 palette, shortcuts, onboarding, profile, workflows list, realistic mock seed.
Every new API route declares a permission; the route-walk test passes (p12).

Leak matrix extended to tag aggregates, stats, saved views, bulk and merge records, archive state, alert rules and history, subscriptions, mentions, activity, external issue bodies, weekly report and integration status (p17).
Screenshot smoke covers every new page and state in light and dark with zero browser errors on a seed of at least 40 issues across statuses (p03 list, p17 strict run).
mise run ci passes offline; src/web typecheck, vitest, build and screenshots pass; README, design docs and impl-plans index updated and v13 plans archived (p17).

Run 1 outcome: the wave-1 contracts (vocabulary, permissions, settings, ports, router split, models and 0004_v1_3, UI client/mock/components/routes/screenshot list) plus the stream backend (B2, B3, B5, S1, S2), the triage lifecycle backend (S4, priority, For review, group helpers, ingest hooks), the notifications backend (S7) and the UI stream (B3, B4, B5 UI) are implemented and verified.
nonGoals: Deferred by the accepted review (section 5): releases and 'resolve in next release', environments, projects, Discover, Jira create (link by URL covers Jira), replay/performance/profiling.
No dependency change: pyproject.toml, uv.lock, src/web/package.json and src/web/bun.lock unchanged; no new heavy UI dependency (hand-rendered SVG charts).
No edit of existing Alembic migrations (0001_initial, 0002_v1_1, 0003_v1_2); no change to tools/typelint.py, ruff ANN/PGH or ty strictness; no per-file-ignore entries.
Meilisearch is not used for the stream (D7); archive never becomes permanent suppression (D2, D3).
Run 1 does not wire new routers or bindings (p12, run 3) and does not touch detail, alerts, dashboard, integrations, directory/ownership or the later UI pages.
constraints: AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md: English only, no emojis, python-coding-standards; plan files under 400 lines; every Python file under 1000 lines (api/routers/issues.py split by p01, issues/service.py split by p05 into ingest_transitions.py).
Strict typing via tools/typelint.py, ruff ANN/PGH and ty; no type-ignore or ty-ignore; no Any, object, dict/mapping types or **kwargs; dataclasses and enums only.

Raw detected values are never persisted, logged, indexed, notified or returned; saved view names/queries, comments, external issue bodies and alert payloads pass Redactor (and the DLP gate before egress) and hold masked values or fingerprints only; errors never echo the query.
Default uv run pytest passes offline; integration tests skip without TELESCREEN_TEST_DATABASE_URL / TELESCREEN_TEST_MEILI_URL; live tests (tests/live, marker live) skip offline.
Database changes only via the new idempotent revision 0004_v1_3 (down_revision 0003_v1_2).
New Protocol methods go into new Protocols; new fields on existing DTOs and services are defaulted so wiring.py compiles unchanged until p12.

Conventions 2 and 7a: write only inside writePaths; a needed change elsewhere is a Reconciliation request; fixed findings only in addressedFeedback; verification lists only final passing commands; offline-skipped integration/live tests and /tmp outputs are not risks.
No git checkout/restore/stash/reset/clean/commit/add by workers; bun install only with --frozen-lockfile; builds and logs go to /tmp.
designDecisionsAndRationale: D1: UNRESOLVED_STATUSES (unresolved, acknowledged, in_progress, regressed, escalating) is the open set behind is:unresolved and the Unresolved tab (fixes B3); OPEN_STATUSES adds escalating and archived so reconciliation still covers them.
D2-D4: new archived and escalating statuses; ignored stays approved-exception only; every archive ends by archived_at + 90 days; escalation on condition met or widened exposure.
D5-D6: priority derived from severity until set manually; needs_review set on create/regress/escalate/system unarchive/verification failure and cleared by any human triage action.
D7-D10: server-side SQL query parser (no Meilisearch), period scoping, Values = distinct_fingerprints, server saved views gated by Redactor with personal/shared visibility.
D12-D13: merge keeps child rows (merged_into_id), recomputes group counters, cascades group actions, rejects exception requests on group members (merged_group).
D16: ActorDirectory port resolves actor refs to display names (fixes B4/B6 without exposing raw ids).

D22-D24: per-member notification categories; direct categories choose the channel, alerts/workflow_tasks only filter member recipients; sla_escalated is never filtered; weekly report through a cron provider and the editable system.weekly_report template.

Plan DAG: wave-1 contracts first; p01 splits issues.py mechanically and hands issues_common.py/issues_list.py to p04, issues_actions.py to p05 and the template built-ins to p09 as single later editors; p04 is the single wave-2 owner of the shared item serializer and the counts router must be registered before the issues router (contract for p12).
intentionalTradeoffs: Runs are capped at 8 plans because earlier sessions hit the 1M-token prompt limit in implementation-wave-outcome; this manifest dispatches 7 plans and leaves 10 accepted plans to later manifests (laterRunPlans).

Manifest scoped ruff/ty commands are narrowed to each plan's own write and shared paths (conventions 7 'YOUR paths') instead of whole directories that contain sibling plans' in-progress files; typelint still runs on the whole repository and is filtered to the plan's paths.

p05's tests/issues regression run ignores tests/issues/v13_query (p04's in-progress tests). p04's tests/api/v11_issues run and p05's tests/api/v11_issues run execute while the sibling edits issues_list.py or issues_actions.py; a failure caused by the sibling's in-progress file is recorded as such in the Progress Log, own failures are fixed. p12 and p17 rerun the full suite after the joins.
p01 and p02 require the full offline suite to pass during wave 1; p04, p05 and p09 record the full suite as informational Progress Log evidence only (not manifest verification).
p05 tests never assert on the _issue_json fields p04 adds (rule at v13-p05 :223-224); only status code and id of responses.
Low residual (comm-000487): the p03 mock query evaluator duplicates the p04 server parser semantics; p17 E1 checks the server behavior against it.
p03 screenshots run in non-strict mode (missing targets log state-skipped); p17 runs TELESCREEN_SCREENSHOTS_STRICT=1. A missing browser is a recorded verification gap, never a pass.

Every plan declares artifactRoots none: no plan installs tools into the repository beyond the gitignored src/web/node_modules from bun install --frozen-lockfile, and outputs go to /tmp or the gitignored tmp/ui-screenshots.
supportedEdgeCases: assigned:none and legacy assignee=none return only unassigned issues and never reach the recipient resolver (B2).

Negated terms for every key, key:[a,b] lists, quoted values, TELE-n free text, LIKE text with % and _ escaped; more than 20 tokens or 1000 characters, unknown keys and invalid enum values give 422 invalid_query with token_index and reason and no echo of the query.
Merged children never appear in the list or counts; trends include children's findings.
Saved views: sample secret in name or query -> 422 with no row; 51st personal view -> limit_exceeded; shared view without views.manage_shared -> 403; unbound token -> 403.

Archive from a non-open status -> invalid_transition; count 0 or duration 200000 -> validation_error; expiry tick returns the issue as unresolved with system:archive history; exposure widening while archived escalates; exception approval and verification requests clear archive fields; merge/rebase never escalates or extends archive_until.

Notification settings: defaults by available address; opted-out member gets a skipped row with recipient_opted_out and no task; slack without a Slack id -> 422 recipient_unreachable; uncategorized v1.2 requests are byte-for-byte unchanged; weekly report enqueued once per fire.

UI: the raw query string is always sent; client validation only marks tokens; shortcuts are ignored inside editable elements; bulk failures are shown, not dropped; the auto-refresh banner never reorders the list.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Live PostgreSQL/Meilisearch behavior beyond marked integration tests skipped offline.
Live Slack, Mailpit and Keycloak checks (tests/live/v13, p17 in run 3).
Route registration order and real bindings in the running app (p12, run 3); run-1 API tests build their own apps in the documented order.
Releases, environments, projects, Discover and Jira create (deferred).
lowFindingsCarried: comm-000487 residual (Low): the p03 mock query evaluator duplicates the p04 server parser semantics; p17 E1 checks server behavior against it.
